name: consignment-packing-app
description: Modern full-stack consignment packing station application with Firebase

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:security: cd backend && node ../scripts/run-with-test-env.cjs run test:security && cd ../frontend && npm run test:security
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
